scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});for(const item of ['index.html','embed.html','o3dv','assets']){if(fs.existsSync(item)){fs.cpSync(item,path.join('dist',item),{recursive:true});}}for(const f of ['libredwg-wasm-base64.js','occt-worker-base64.js']){const p=path.join('dist','assets','libs',f);if(fs.existsSync(p))fs.rmSync(p,{force:true});}console.log('Built clean static assets into ./dist for Cloudflare deployment.');"
